parsed.name: CBox驱动的Transmon超导量子比特
parsed.description: 一种通过微波脉冲、读出谐振腔和通量脉冲进行控制与测量的Transmon超导量子比特，并配合CBox电子学完成时序与采集。该器件常用于量子计算实验中的能谱测量、Rabi、T1、Ramsey、回波、单次读出、随机基准测试，以及通量脉冲和CZ相关相位表征。
parsed.description_en: A superconducting transmon qubit controlled and measured with microwave pulses, a readout resonator, and flux pulses, using CBox-based electronics for timing and acquisition. It is used in quantum computing experiments for spectroscopy, Rabi, T1, Ramsey, echo, single-shot readout, randomized benchmarking, and characterization of flux pulses and CZ-related phase behavior.

actions.description: 定义该Transmon实验所需的时域、读出及混频校准参数。
actions.description_en: Define time-domain, readout, and mixer-calibration parameters for the transmon experiment.

actions.description: 上传用于控制该量子比特实验的脉冲序列程序。
actions.description_en: Upload the pulse-sequence program used to control the qubit experiment.

actions.description: 将量子比特与读出链路配置为连续波测量模式。
actions.description_en: Configure the qubit and readout chain for continuous-wave measurements.

actions.description: 配置读出频率、读出脉冲和采集设置。
actions.description_en: Configure readout frequency, readout pulse, and acquisition settings.

actions.description: 将该Transmon配置为脉冲时域测量模式。
actions.description_en: Configure the transmon for pulsed time-domain measurements.

actions.description: 配置该量子比特的通量脉冲实验模式。
actions.description_en: Configure the qubit for flux-pulse experiments.

actions.description: 用restless方法校准量子比特控制脉冲的幅度、Motzoi参数和频率。
actions.description_en: Calibrate qubit control-pulse amplitude, Motzoi parameter, and frequency using a restless method.

actions.description: 校准驱动链路I/Q混频器的直流偏置。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the DC offsets of the drive-path I/Q mixer.

actions.description: 校准读出链路I/Q混频器的直流偏置。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the DC offsets of the readout-path I/Q mixer.

actions.description: 校准I/Q混频器的幅相不平衡与偏斜。
actions.description_en: Calibrate I/Q mixer imbalance and skew.

actions.description: 校准微波控制脉冲与读出脉冲之间的时延。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the timing delay between microwave control and readout pulses.

actions.description: 进行外差频谱测量以表征量子比特或读出谐振腔响应。
actions.description_en: Perform heterodyne spectroscopy to characterize the qubit or readout-resonator response.

actions.description: 测量量子比特频谱响应。
actions.description_en: Measure the qubit spectroscopy response.

actions.description: 进行脉冲式量子比特频谱测量。
actions.description_en: Perform pulsed qubit spectroscopy.

actions.description: 测量读出谐振腔对频率和激励功率的响应。
actions.description_en: Measure the readout resonator response versus frequency and probe power.

actions.description: 测量读出谐振腔对频率和DAC驱动设置的响应。
actions.description_en: Measure the readout resonator response versus frequency and DAC drive setting.

actions.description: 测量Rabi振荡以标定驱动脉冲强度。
actions.description_en: Measure Rabi oscillations to calibrate drive-pulse strength.

actions.description: 测量控制脉冲对Motzoi参数的依赖，用于DRAG类校准。
actions.description_en: Measure control-pulse dependence on the Motzoi parameter for DRAG-style calibration.

actions.description: 通过随机基准测试测量单量子比特门保真度。
actions.description_en: Measure single-qubit gate fidelity using randomized benchmarking.

actions.description: 测量随机基准测试结果随控制参数变化的关系。
actions.description_en: Measure randomized-benchmarking performance versus control parameters.

actions.description: 测量量子比特的能量弛豫时间T1。
actions.description_en: Measure the qubit energy-relaxation time T1.

actions.description: 测量Ramsey条纹以表征失相干与频率偏移。
actions.description_en: Measure Ramsey fringes to characterize dephasing and frequency detuning.

actions.description: 测量回波序列以表征相干时间。
actions.description_en: Measure an echo sequence to characterize coherence time.

actions.description: 执行AllXY序列以校准单量子比特门操作。
actions.description_en: Perform the AllXY sequence to calibrate single-qubit gate operations.

actions.description: 测量重复翻转序列，以评估π脉冲精度和失谐效应。
actions.description_en: Measure repeated flipping sequences to assess pi-pulse accuracy and detuning effects.

actions.description: 测量单次读出性能与态判别能力。
actions.description_en: Measure single-shot readout performance and state-discrimination capability.

actions.description: 测量量子比特处于不同状态时的读出瞬态响应。
actions.description_en: Measure readout transients for different qubit states.

actions.description: 校准读出判别所需的最佳积分权重。
actions.description_en: Calibrate optimal integration weights for readout discrimination.

actions.description: 测量butterfly读出实验以评估初始化与读出相关性。
actions.description_en: Perform a butterfly readout experiment to assess initialization and readout correlations.

actions.description: 测量随机基准测试结果随驱动幅度的变化。
actions.description_en: Measure randomized-benchmarking performance versus drive amplitude.

actions.description: 校准通量脉冲相对于微波控制和读出的时延。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the timing delay of flux pulses relative to microwave control and readout.

actions.description: 测量通量脉冲与微波脉冲之间的相对时序。
actions.description_en: Measure the relative timing between flux pulses and microwave pulses.

actions.description: 测量通量脉冲长度引起的相位累积（Ram-Z实验）。
actions.description_en: Measure phase accumulation versus flux-pulse length in a Ram-Z experiment.

actions.description: 通过量子比特响应表征通量脉冲波形的时间演化。
actions.description_en: Characterize the time evolution of a flux-pulse waveform through the qubit response.

actions.description: 测量带回波的通量诱导相位累积。
actions.description_en: Measure flux-induced phase accumulation using an echo-based sequence.

actions.description: 测量CZ类通量脉冲相关的相位起伏与附加相位。
actions.description_en: Measure phase ripple and accumulated phase associated with CZ-type flux pulses.

actions.description: 定义该Transmon实验可用的微波、通量、频谱和读出操作集合。
actions.description_en: Define the available microwave, flux, spectroscopy, and readout operations for the transmon experiment.

actions.description: 测量单量子比特门集层析以完整表征门操作。
actions.description_en: Perform single-qubit gate set tomography to fully characterize gate operations.

actions.description: 将控制或通量脉冲波形加载到波形发生器中用于量子比特实验。
actions.description_en: Load control or flux-pulse waveforms into the waveform generator for the qubit experiment.
